pin_title: 7 Halloween Half-Term Activities for Kids Under £20 UK Parents Love
pin_title_alt: 3 Spooky Little Extras Kids Will Love This Halloween
pin_hook: Keep little monsters busy all half-term
pin_description: Halloween half-term activities for kids under £20: glow in the dark skeleton pyjamas, treat boxes, glow tattoos, reusable sticker books and spooky stationery. Easy Halloween ideas for toddlers and school-age kids, rainy day crafts and party bag fillers UK parents rate highly. #ad #halloweenkids #halfterm #halloweenactivities #ukdeals
intro: Half-term and Halloween land in the same week, so here are some well-loved, low-cost bits to keep kids busy and in the spooky spirit. Everything here is under £20 and rated highly by UK parents.

products.name: JOYIN 24 Pcs Halloween Trick or Treat Candy Boxes
products.headline: Fill, decorate and hand out spooky treats
products.why: A big pack of printed treat boxes with handles that kids can fill for friends, cousins or a Halloween party. Handy for home baking too.

products.name: Kids' Glow in the Dark Skeleton Halloween Pyjamas
products.headline: Spooky bedtime that doubles as a costume
products.why: Cotton skeleton pyjamas that glow in the dark, so they work for bedtime and as an easy last-minute costume. A cheap, popular choice for toddlers and younger kids.

products.name: ACWOO Luminous Halloween Temporary Tattoos for Kids
products.headline: Instant spooky fun that glows in the dark
products.why: Ten sheets of glow-in-the-dark pumpkins, bats and skulls that kids can share at a party or wear trick-or-treating. Lots of parents rate them.

products.name: Kalysky 3 Pack Halloween Reusable Sticker Books
products.headline: Quiet-time fun for toddlers, again and again
products.why: Three Halloween scene books with stickers that peel off and go back on, so they last well beyond one rainy afternoon. Aimed at ages 2-4.

products.name: JOYIN 144 Pcs Halloween Stationery Gift Set
products.headline: 24 ready-made goody packs in one box
products.why: Pencils, erasers, notepads and stickers split into 24 packs, which makes party bags or class treats easy. A good non-sweet alternative for trick-or-treaters.

products.name: JOYIN 48 Halloween Pencils with Erasers
products.headline: Spooky colouring and drawing sessions sorted
products.why: A big set of wooden pencils in six Halloween designs with fun erasers. Great for half-term colouring or handing out instead of sweets.

products.name: Henbrandt 12 Halloween Sticker Sheets
products.headline: Pocket-money spooky stickers for crafts
products.why: Twelve sheets of mini Halloween stickers for cards, crafts or party bags. A tiny buy that keeps younger kids happily busy.
